quote: Life is perhaps eternal, and therefore work is eternal. If this is so, let us do our day’s work bravely.
source: George Sand, The George Sand-Gustave Flaubert Letters, Letter CCCII, to Flaubert, 12 January 1876 (trans. Aimée L. McKenzie, 1921)

evidence.where: Project Gutenberg #5115, the full text of the McKenzie translation, fetched and searched this run
evidence.edition: The George Sand-Gustave Flaubert Letters, trans. Aimée L. McKenzie, intro. Stuart P. Sherman (Boni and Liveright, New York, 1921)
evidence.locator: Letter CCCII, TO GUSTAVE FLAUBERT, in Paris, Nohant, 12th January, 1876

reason: Both sentences stand verbatim and contiguous in Letter CCCII, headed Nohant, 12th January, 1876, in the McKenzie text. Not shipped, George Sand at zero of three, not banned; a letter, so Correspondence.
